description:
Instantiate the 8 reference MemoryBackends from the workspace's extension-server crates, register each crate's handler functions with jmap_server::Dispatcher, and mount them at a single account-id under a single principal so a JMAP client can issue calls across all 8 extensions through the same testjig instance.

The 8 extension server crates and their register_* functions:
- jmap-mail-server::register_mail_handlers
- jmap-chat-server::register_chat_handlers
- jmap-calendars-server::register_calendar_handlers (verify exact name)
- jmap-tasks-server::register_tasks_handlers (verify exact name)
- jmap-contacts-server::register_contacts_handlers (verify exact name)
- jmap-filenode-server::register_filenode_handlers (verify exact name)
- jmap-sharing-server::register_sharing_handlers (verify exact name)
- jmap-metadata-server::register_metadata_handlers (verify exact name)

The dispatcher needs a CallerCtx type that all 8 backends share. For the testjig that's '()' (single hardcoded principal, no per-request identity). MemoryBackends use 'type CallerCtx = ();' already so this lines up.

## Acceptance

- A JMAP request like {methodCalls: [['Mailbox/get', {accountId: ...}, 'c1']]} works
- A JMAP request like {methodCalls: [['Chat/get', {accountId: ...}, 'c1']]} works
- Cross-extension requests in a single envelope (e.g. Email/get + Chat/get back-to-back) succeed
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings clean
- cargo test --workspace clean
